newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran executes man for 1984 hijacking.
newsitem.headline: Iran executes man for 1984 hijacking.

text.p: Iran has executed a man who hijacked an Iranian passenger plane in 1984 and had disguised himself as a woman while on the run, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said on Tuesday.
It quoted a Tehran Islamic Revolutionary court as saying Gholamreza Vahidjou was hanged last Wednesday, two days after the supreme court turned down his appeal.
A lower court sentenced him to death last November after finding him guilty of hijacking an Iranian Boeing 727 airliner which was on a domestic flight to Cairo in 1984.
Vahidjou was arrested last year following his return to Iran after spending several years in Iraq, Turkey and France. He lived undercover in Iran disguised as a woman, IRNA said.
During his trial in an open court, Vahidjou admitted taking part in the hijacking but said it was planned by an accomplice who was still at large, the agency said.
